question: Which pending approval requests are older than the selected age?

steps.name: requests
steps.soql: SELECT Id, ProcessInstance.TargetObjectId, ProcessInstance.Status, ActorId, OriginalActorId, CreatedDate, ElapsedTimeInDays FROM ProcessInstanceWorkitem WHERE ProcessInstance.Status = 'Pending' AND CreatedDate < LAST_N_DAYS:{days} ORDER BY CreatedDate ASC LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: {requests.rows} row(s) returned by the first query. Review selected columns, query limits and follow-up steps; this is not an org-wide assessment.

traps: Covers approval work items exposed by ProcessInstanceWorkitem, not every approval product or flow.
Elapsed age does not establish a missed service commitment. Oldest returned items may be limited.
